Villain's-Eye Plan.name: Villain's-Eye Plan
Villain's-Eye Plan.description: The user looks at an attack the way its planners did: who was hit first, which exits were cut, who is being kept alive. The user learns the attackers' true objective in this scene (a person, an object or a distraction) and the route they will take to reach it, so the user's side can get there first. Cost: none.
